events.command:
# Count genes with treeness > 0.06 (skip header)
ABOVE=$(tail -n +2 /workspace/treeness_output.txt | awk -F'\t' '$5+0 > 0.06' | wc -l)

# Total genes = 255 (all .faa files in scogs_fungi.zip). 
# 249 had trees, 6 did not and thus have no treeness > 0.06
TOTAL=255

# Compute percentage
PCT=$(echo "scale=2; $ABOVE * 100 / $TOTAL" | bc)

echo "Genes with treeness > 0.06: $ABOVE"
echo "Total fungal genes: $TOTAL"
echo "Percentage: $PCT%"

# Also show the distribution
echo ""
echo "=== Distribution ==="
tail -n +2 /workspace/treeness_output.txt | awk -F'\t' '{print $5}' | sort -n | awk '
BEGIN { 
  bins[0.00]=0; bins[0.02]=0; bins[0.04]=0; bins[0.06]=0; bins[0.08]=0; bins[0.10]=0 
}
{
  if ($1 <= 0.02) bins[0.00]++
  else if ($1 <= 0.04) bins[0.02]++
  else if ($1 <= 0.06) bins[0.04]++
  else if ($1 <= 0.08) bins[0.06]++
  else if ($1 <= 0.10) bins[0.08]++
  else bins[0.10]++
}
END {
  for (b in bins) printf "  <= %.2f: %d\n", b+0.02, bins[b]
}' | sort -t' ' -k2 -n
